#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Testing Git Deployment System ==="

# Clean up any existing test directories
rm -rf /tmp/test-clone

echo "1. Cloning repository via file protocol..."
git clone file:///git/project.git /tmp/test-clone
cd /tmp/test-clone

echo "2. Creating main branch with index.html..."
echo "main branch test content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Test main branch"
git branch -M main
git push file:///git/project.git main

echo "3. Creating dev branch with index.html..."
git checkout -b dev
echo "dev branch test content" > index.html
git add index.html
git commit -m "Test dev branch"
git push file:///git/project.git dev

echo "4. Waiting for deployment..."
sleep 3

echo "5. Testing HTTPS endpoints..."
echo "Main branch content:"
curl -k -s https://localhost:8443/index.html
echo ""
echo "Dev branch content:"
curl -k -s https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html
echo ""

echo "6. Verifying deployment directories..."
echo "Main directory:"
ls -la /var/www/html/main/
echo "Dev directory:"
ls -la /var/www/html/dev/

echo "=== Test Complete ==="
